study: Jacob, Hill & Corey 2017 (Math Solutions PD RCT, JREE 10(2):379-407)
delivery_evidence: PD = week-long in-person summer institutes each summer plus 4-6 in-service days/year; report notes 'Distance learning and coaching were proposed by the Math Solutions team but not taken up by the teachers,' so delivery was face-to-face (Methods/PD description, narrative p.36).
test_alignment_evidence: Included outcomes are a researcher-developed math assessment (proximal/aligned) and the state standardized math test (broad independent measure); both extracted (Table 8, p.67).
curriculum_evidence: Math Solutions PD is 'not designed around any specific curricular program but is designed to adapt to any curriculum in use by a district' — it improves teachers' MKT/practice with the existing district curriculum; no new curriculum/materials adopted (intro/intervention description).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effect sizes are the T4 (spring of Year 3) wave, the end of the 3-year treatment = same-period/immediate post-intervention (Table 8, p.67).
